svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
ola/modules/cable/ - Cable, reflection with open end
When it is seen: measurement in reflection, with the far end open (the default case of
What to draw: the VNA with only P1 connected. The cable under test starts from P1 (through the
test lead) and ends in the air: the connector at the other end is left free, with a open-
circuit symbol (broken line) or the word OPEN.
Details: P2 empty (not connected, perhaps with a cap or simply without a wire); the far end
clearly visible, because that is where the user must take care not to connect anything.
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
